findings.description: F-1: Audit-brief claim '7D MDD=0.2885>0.10 hard risk fail (FG5)' is refuted by the frozen population: recomputed source MDD=0.088350<=0.10 (canonical and R4-rerun byte-consistent; XG5 PASS, mdd_lock_blocker=false). The 0.28852 figure originates only from the superseded buggy R2 rerun (env-deletion of PORTFOLIO_SIGNAL_FAMILY, fixed fe31440) and coincides with the unrelated v6p MOM trial. No impact on family outcome: 7D remains ineligible via FG3 top-fold concentration (51.66%>50%), un-gated XG4 robustness, INCONCLUSIVE cell status, and DSR unavailability.

F-2: family_summary fg3 dict omits PLAN section 10 FG3 concentration sub-clauses (top fold <=50%, top symbol <=40%). Recomputed, 7D fails FG3 explicitly on top-fold share; 1D/3D also fail both clauses. Conclusion unchanged.

Relabel recommended per A7 classification in check A7-V6-9.

F-4: exposure_control.jsonl contains zero events on all four real runs (source==rerun, empty-file hash e3b0c442...). Consistent with caps never breached (census max gross 0.96274, |net| 0.06867) but reduce-only enforcement is unevidenced-by-exercise; evidence limited to risk_mode_active flag and margin_breach_rows=0.
